Opus hit 9/9 and satisfied REVIEW DEPTH the strongest way: it introduced a typed SyntaxError and asserted via errors.As rather than merely flagging. Fable/sonnet missed only the Example and the typed-error flag.

LIMITER IS THE REMAINING GAP, and it is adherence, not doctrine: fable 8/9, but opus 5/9 and sonnet 4/9 landed BELOW the 5/9 baseline under the new style assertions -- opus produced seven self-naming doc comments and no Example; sonnet wrote package limiter and a bare TestAllow.
